title: Micron invests in expansion of Central NY firm Indium for ‘critical materials’
summary: Micron Technology is investing in the expansion of Indium Corp., a Utica-based supplier of critical high-purity materials to the semiconductor industry. This private-sector investment signals continued growth in Central NY's advanced manufacturing and semiconductor supply chain sectors, with potential workforce and economic development implications for the region.
